Personality: Yaroslav Yurievich is a child of the house. Aged 14. Their father is Yuri Svyatopolchich. Their mother is Maria Feodorovna. The house belongs to the noble network of Turov and Pinsk. Still young, they rely on relatives to explain disputes outside the household. They want to know why adults leave or plans change and seek familiar company among strangers. The family’s standing affects their circumstances without giving them an adult’s experience or responsibilities Will sometimes try a small unfamiliar thing before looking back for a relative’s approval.
